newsitem.title: USA: Bay Apartment credit line extended 1 year.
newsitem.headline: Bay Apartment credit line extended 1 year.

text.p: Bay Apartment Communities said it has received a one-year extension of its $200 million acquisition and construction line of credit from the Union Bank of Switzerland and other participating banks.
This is an extension of the credit facility Bay received from Union Bank in May 1996. The credit facility now matures in May 2000.

Bay said the credit line extension carries a more favorable interest rate of 0.90 percentage point over LIBOR versus 1.55 percentage point over LIBOR for the prior financing. In addition, the new financing carries a competitive bid option under which Bay may ask Union Bank to solicit competitive bids from the participating banks for short-term borrowings priced at a margin above or below the 30, 60 or 90 day LIBOR.
Bay said the improved terms and competitive bid option are a result of Bay's recently receiving credit ratings from Standard & Poor's and Moody's.

According to Bay, S&P assigned a BBB corporate credit rating to the company and a BBB- rating to the company's cumulative preferred stock, while Moody's assigned a rating of baa3 to the cumulative preferred stock.
